SAS® Marketing Automation
SAS® Marketing Automation
Plan, test and execute marketing campaigns with marketing automation software. SAS Marketing Automation helps you analyze customer profitability, improve data quality and create customized, repeatable processes.

Learn
Documentation
Support
white marble texture
The most recent release is SAS Marketing Automation 6.7 on SAS 9.4M9.

SAS Marketing Automation 6.7 does not contain any new features or capabilities. Consider SAS Customer Intelligence 360 for your business needs instead. 

Note: SAS Marketing Automation is not available in SAS 9.4M8.

Documentation
Find user's guides and other technical documentation for SAS Marketing Automation.

SAS Marketing Automation 6.7

The documentation for SAS Marketing Automation is provided on a secure site that requires an access key. Licensed customers can request the access key from SAS Technical Support. Expedite your request by including "SAS Customer Intelligence" in the subject field of the form.
